authority_context: FREE_ONLY; owner emergency-stop FreeSwarm HARD_OFF; no provider probes; Together forbidden
required_execution: Use clay-direct-dev or the host actually owning the post-stop provider-capable legacy processes.
Checkout the pinned commit in a clean detached worktree and verify dirty=false.
Run the enforcer first without --apply and preserve the dry-run JSON receipt.
Verify the selected roots are only exact legacy FreeSwarm/provider-capable scripts and their PPID descendants; unrelated Xeno/Trigger2/repository services must not be selected.

If and only if canonical FREE_PROVIDER_ADMISSION remains OWNER_EMERGENCY_STOP_FREE_SWARM_HARD_OFF, run: python3 tools/free_swarm_runtime_quiescence_enforcer_v1.py --repo . --apply --window-seconds 60 --output /tmp/free_swarm_quiescence_enforcer_receipt.json
Preserve before process tree, termination events, zero-survivor check, bounded quiescence probe receipt, HEAD/tree/runtime/source hashes and stdout/stderr hashes.
Do not make any provider/model call as part of this execution.
Do not execute or promote GRID10 in the same authority step; a fresh non-provider execution-authority re-entry is required after quiescence PASS.
fail_closed: Any ambiguity in root matching => stop before --apply.
Any admission state other than HARD_OFF => stop before --apply.
Any inability to observe counters/processes => INCOMPLETE, not PASS.
next_if_pass: Re-enter current FREE non-provider execution authority, then rerun/rebind physical GRID10 under the valid quiescence->authority predecessor chain.
